name: Open Printer
summary: The team plans to launch its Crowd Supply campaign in autumn 2026. The campaign is not live yet; final pricing, an exact launch date, and a shipping date have not been announced in the reviewed sources.

officialLinks.label: September 17, 2026: On the Road to Launch

confirmedFacts: In its September 17 update, the team reports beta testing, software refinement, and production-logistics planning. It plans an autumn 2026 crowdfunding launch; this is not a shipping commitment.
The team says the exact campaign launch date, roadmap, complete specifications, and final pricing will be shared in a future update.
The developers state planned CUPS support and HP 63, HP 302, and HP 803 cartridge compatibility by region.
The developers state that project files will use CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, while also saying files will be released only after the final version is ready.
Open Tools says patent and design registrations have been filed.
dataBoundary: These are developer-published plans, not independently verified product performance. No retail unit, final speed, campaign price, shipment date, reliability record, or long-term parts supply was established by the reviewed pages.
